results.name: Dumbbell Side Lunge Single Leg
instructions: Stand with your feet together, holding a dumbbell with both hands close to your chest.
Take a large step to your left with your left foot, bending your left knee and lowering your hips down and back as if you are sitting into a chair. Keep your right leg straight.
Lower yourself until your left thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position. Perform all repetitions on the left side before switching to the right side and repeating the exercise.
tips: Keep your back straight and avoid leaning forward excessively.
Keep your feet facing forward and your weight distributed evenly.
Make sure your knee stays aligned with your toes during the lunge to prevent strain.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Lunge Single Leg is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Adductors.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Squat Side to Side
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell close to your chest.
Shift your weight to your right leg, bending your knee and pushing your hips back to lower into a side lunge. Keep your left leg straight and your chest up.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, straightening your leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement.
Engage your core to maintain balance and stability.
Avoid letting your knees collapse inward; keep them aligned with your toes.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Squat Side to Side is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Adductors.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Press the dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Step forward with your right foot into a lunge position, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, maintaining the dumbbell overhead throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes during the lunge.
Maintain an upright posture, keeping your chest up and shoulders back.
Focus on a controlled descent into the lunge to avoid straining your knee joints.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise Wall Support
instructions: Stand with your right side facing a wall, placing your right hand on the wall for support and holding a dumbbell in your left hand. Lift your right leg off the floor, balancing on your left leg.
Press through your eight forefoot to raise your heel off the floor as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, squeezing your calf muscle.
Lower your heel back to the starting position in a controlled manner. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement.
Maintain a straight posture, avoiding leaning forward or backward.
Exhale as you lift your heel and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise Wall Support is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand extended down in front of you. Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the floor behind you.
Begin to hinge at your hips, extending your right leg straight behind you while lowering the dumbbells towards the floor. Keep a slight bend in your left knee.
Lower the dumbbells until your torso is parallel to the floor, or as far as your flexibility allows, maintaining a straight line from your head to your right heel.

Return to the starting position by driving through your left heel and bringing your right leg forward, keeping it off the floor. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left hand and right leg.
tips: Ensure your back stays straight throughout the exercise to avoid injury.
Focus on a point in front of you to help maintain balance.
Exhale as you lower the dumbbell and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against the edge of a flat bench. Plant one foot firmly on the floor, extend the opposite leg straight in front of you, and hold a dumbbell securely across your hips with both hands.
Press through your planted foot and extend your hips upward while keeping the opposite leg straight and elevated.
Lift until your torso and supporting thigh form a straight line, then pause briefly and squeeze your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips toward the floor while keeping the extended leg raised, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your upper back firmly supported against the bench throughout the movement.
Drive through the heel and middle of your planted foot rather than your toes.
Keep your hips level and avoid rotating toward the raised leg.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you press them upward.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Hip Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Core, Obliques.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Single Arm Deadlift
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together and hold a dumbbell by your side using a neutral grip. Shift your weight onto the leg opposite the dumbbell and slightly bend your supporting knee.
Lift the leg on the dumbbell side behind you with your knee bent as you push your hips back and hinge your torso forward.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor beside your supporting leg until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight and your hips level.
Press through your supporting foot and drive your hips forward to return upright, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Lower the dumbbell close to your supporting leg instead of reaching it forward.
Keep your supporting knee aligned with your toes and balance over the middle of your foot.
Keep your hips level and avoid rotating your torso toward either side.
Inhale as you hinge forward and exhale as you return to standing.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Single Arm Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Obliques, Lower Back.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Split Squat
instructions: Begin by standing with your back facing a bench. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Lift your left foot back to rest on the bench behind you.

Lower your body into a squat position by bending your right knee, keeping your torso upright. Your right knee should align over your ankle, and your left knee should lower towards the floor without touching it.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position, straightening your right leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes.
Keep your front foot firmly planted.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Split Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat With Support (Pistol)
instructions: Stand next to a lifting cage and hold the lifting cage bar for support with your right hand. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand, allowing it to hang down to your side. Position your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right leg off the floor and extend it forward.
Bend your right knee to lower your body into a squat position. Lower yourself as far as you can while maintaining control and balance.
Press through the heel of your right leg to return to the starting position, fully extending your leg. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and avoid leaning forward excessively.
Focus on maintaining balance by using the support lightly, not relying on it entirely.
Perform the movement in a slow and controlled manner to ensure proper form and muscle engagement.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat With Support (Pistol) is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Glutes.

results.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat
instructions: Begin by standing on your right leg, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Lift your left leg slightly off the floor, keeping it straight and extended in front of you.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your right knee. Your left leg should remain extended in front of you without touching the floor.
Lower until your right thigh is parallel to the floor, ensuring your knee stays aligned with your foot and doesn't go past your toes.
Push through your right heel to return to standing position, keeping your left leg extended. Repeat for the desired repetitions, then switch to the left leg.
tips: Start with a lower weight or no weight to master the form before increasing the resistance.
Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
Keep your balance by engaging your core and focusing on a fixed point in front of you.
results.description: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.
